items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I was working at Cafe Society with J. C. Heard... Well, it was J. C. Heard, he had the band, and there was Dicky Wells... and Al McKibbon... Let's see, who was -- Bud Johnson... It was a nice little group

ctx.x: Yeah, you see, you can get it from there. And I think I met Eubie the next year, '46. I was working at Cafe Society with J. C. Heard (PHONETIC), and that's when I first met Sarah. And --
You were working with J. C. Heard and whom?
